articles.title: Expedition Unknown S17E04 1080p WEB h264-FREQUENCY
articles.summary: A TV episode documents an expedition diving into the frigid Baltic Sea in search of the revolutionary Nazi submarine V-80. Known as a "super sub," it was ordered scuttled by Hitler to prevent its capture by Allied forces. The search uncovers this historical enigma, shedding light on advanced World War II naval technology and a crucial wartime act to safeguard military secrets.
